summary: Owner rule 2026-10-22: the budget estimates, it never limits the user. Per-operation caps become estimates; Gateway refuses only a request beyond the model window; conversations (reader QA, page-image QA, translation, project-creation chat) ask for the model's maximum answer and send the whole abstract, retrieved passages, session history, selection and messages, with no turn or length caps; background structured operations keep their output guard.
scope_note: Worktree ai-no-caps from main 46b807e. Owner decision recorded in harness/budget.json owner_approval_note and ADR 0037; not self-approved.

quantified.period: one paper_qa call, worst case within its limit; peak cache-miss price arithmetic (input $0.30/M, output $1.20/M), not a measurement

budget_impact.rationale: Owner chose to remove per-call limits on AI conversations. Each conversation turn may now send the whole session history and ask for up to 384K output tokens; the app has no per-call or total spending bound (totals were removed on 2026-10-09). Default local paths stay at zero model tokens.
budget_impact.before: paper_qa cap 4200 in / 1100 out with passages dropped and abstract cut to 800; translate 1200 chars; guidance 1200/500, 6 turns, 40 messages
budget_impact.after: only the model window (1M tokens by a conservative UTF-8 byte bound) refuses; conversations request up to 384K output (about $0.46 at peak cache-miss price, arithmetic only); background operations unchanged

additional_checks.scope: 0 of 1131 Chinese UI strings missing an English entry

reviews.reviewer: Separate review agent (Opus), read-only; no blocking finding, six should-fix findings resolved or kept by owner choice as recorded

open_risks: No real model call: answer quality with long histories, latency near the window and real billing are unmeasured.
project_guidance runs in JSON mode with the model's maximum output by owner choice; a whitespace runaway would cost about $0.46 and minutes of waiting before failing as truncated.
Structured operations still choose bounded inputs by design (e.g. concept_intro), and the learning-path daily attempt limit remains; both outside the owner's conversation scope.
